records.omission_quote:
We attempted to replicate Berinsky’s 2017 experiment on belief in rumors surrounding the Affordable Care Act
(ACA), specifically the false rumor that the ACA would
create “death panels” that would make end-of-life decisions
for patients without their consent.

in political misinformation. British Journal of Political
